core_principles: Command-center focus: High density, extreme clarity, and tactical minimalism.
Color is strictly functional: Green for profit/buy, Red for loss/sell. No generic gradients.
Grid Borders Strategy: Use 1px sharp borders to expose the skeleton, creating a true terminal feel.
Bento grid architecture: Strict compartmentation, sizes dictate hierarchy. Dense spacing.
Monospace priority: All financial figures, tickers, and code must use monospaced typography for precision.

guidelines: Never use default generic fonts. Use Chivo for primary headings to give authoritative weight.
Always use JetBrains Mono for prices, PnL, API keys, code editor, and numerical data.
Ensure all bento cards stretch to match heights using h-full and flex flex-col.
Containers with borders must have internal padding. Use minimal padding (p-4) to maximize data density.
Use strict compartmentation so dense financial info stays scannable.

rules: Expose the grid. Use 1px subtle borders (border-[#262626]) around cards.
No soft shadows or glows. Tactical minimalism only.
For code editors or terminal views, apply Retro-Futurism touch: Deep black background (#000000) with JetBrains Mono, maybe subtle scanlines or pure stark contrast.

buttons: Primary Action: bg-[#007AFF] text-white hover:bg-[#005bb5] rounded-sm.
Buy Button: bg-[#00E676] text-black font-bold hover:opacity-80.
Sell Button: bg-[#FF3B30] text-white font-bold hover:opacity-80.
tables: Border-collapse style. border-b border-[#262626] for rows.
inputs_and_forms: bg-[#050505] border border-[#262626] rounded-sm text-white focus:border-[#007AFF] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#007AFF].
Use monospaced fonts for API key inputs, amounts, and tickers.
charts: Use Recharts. Line charts for equity curves, Bar charts for volume.
No grid lines or very subtle (#1A1A1A). Tooltips must be dark (#121212) with sharp borders.
Colors must match accent profit/loss variables.
tabs: Underline style preferred over pill style. border-b-2 border-transparent data-[state=active]:border-[#007AFF] data-[state=active]:text-white rounded-none.
navigation_and_header: Top sticky nav: bg-[#0A0A0A] border-b border-[#262626] z-50.
Must show Market Status (Live indicator), Current time (Mono font), Total PnL.

icons.rules: Use stroke-width 1.5. Clean, geometric, unstyled icons.

login_hero.description: Abstract glowing green and red candlestick chart patterns over deep black background. Use this on the Login/Signup split screen to establish the trading vibe.

animations_and_interactions.tickers: Use react-fast-marquee for the top live market watch ticker tape. Slow, continuous, smooth.
animations_and_interactions.hover: Explicit hover states on all interactive elements. Buttons lift slightly (-translate-y-[1px]) or change background color.
animations_and_interactions.transitions: Fast, functional transitions (150ms). No drawn-out or bouncy animations. It's a trading terminal, speed is key.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements, buttons, and forms MUST include role-based data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='run-backtest-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Setup routing for: Login/Signup, Dashboard, API Keys, Python Editor, Visual Builder, Bot Chat.
Install required fonts from Google Fonts: Chivo, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono.
Use react-fast-marquee for the live market ticker at the top of the dashboard.
For the Visual No-Code Builder, construct a simple block-based UI using dense rectangular cards that map to 'IF' and 'THEN' logic.
For the Python Code Editor, use a syntax-highlighting library (like react-simple-code-editor or Monaco) inside a window with a true terminal aesthetic (JetBrains Mono, pure black bg).
Never use pure black or pure white unless specified. Stick to the precise hex codes provided in the colors section.
For the AI Trading Bot Chat page, present a clean dark-mode chat interface with distinctive AI vs User bubbles. Use mono fonts for trade suggestions within the chat.
DO NOT USE Placeholders. Use the provided login_hero image for the auth page.
For broker logos like Zerodha, simply render the name in a clean font or use a generic 'Building'/'Key' lucide-react icon as SVG. No broken placeholder URLs.
